note: 2026-11-26 0.137 trial: two Souls holding hands stood inside each other. New revisions of the Engine v2 entry eden:hold_hands (content/kinds/together/hold_hands.json) and the move souls:hold_hand (content/moves/hold_hand.json). The hold's two stands and slots move from 225 mm to 290 mm either side of its middle, so the members stand 580 mm apart, past the 560 mm two standard bodies (radius 280 mm) need; walking hand in hand keeps the same width, read from the stands. The move's reach goes from 600 mm to 700 mm, as the handshake's and the hug's, so a member placed within a granted spot's reach of its stand still holds. An entry's reference is the hash of its bytes, so the old revisions keep their bytes. The world's pin of the activity kind (serve::activity_kinds) hashes its stands, so eden:hold_hands gets a new pin; the client takes pins from the world's served activities.json, so no client copy changes. The pinned Soul Actions snapshot (v2/crates/replica/cases/form-rules-snapshot) keeps the old bytes until its next refresh. No findings: no budgets, samples or gap checks were relaxed.
